thread:
laura: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a PR to refresh the onboarding walkthrough (trim the long intro, add a tiny Node + Python starter app, and simplify the deploy step). Sharing checklist in a sec.

mike: Love it. Any breaking changes for the SDK snippets?

laura: No breaking changes. I swapped the long auth block for the new short-lived API-key flow example. Kept both examples but made the short one default.

nina: Can you add the migrations note for older token formats? A one-liner would help.

laura: Yep — plan: add a "Token migration" collapsible with curl snippet + link to the token rotation doc.

sam: For the starter apps — can we include a minimal Dockerfile + one-liner deploy via Redwood CLI? I want customers to get to a running app in <5 minutes.

laura: Absolutely. Draft Dockerfile added in PR. Also added a fast deploy command: ```bash
# build + push + deploy
redwoodctl deploy --app examples/starter-node --env demo
```

mike: Nice. For SDK examples: include both callback and async/await patterns and one embedding example. Some customers still use sync patterns in older runtimes.

laura: Done. I kept the older style under "legacy snippets" and added a clear note that we prefer async/await.

deploy-bot: Preview site built: https://deploy-preview.redwooddocs.io/pr-3421 :rocket:

nina: Small nit — link in the auth paragraph points to outdated /docs/auth-v1. Need to change to /docs/auth.

laura: Good catch, fixed and pushed. Also added a tiny test that renders the quickstart in the docs CI so the preview catches broken links.

sam: Can someone review the PR before EOD? I can do a pass tonight for CLI and deploy bits.

mike: I'll review SDK snippets now.

nina: I'll eyeball the token migration note and the curl examples.

laura: Thanks all. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 — ping me for anything blocking. :thumbsup:
